g.text: VACUUM HEATER H-201 & VACUUM COLUMN C-201
1. C-201 is a wet, packed column: 4 beds with chimney-tray draw pans.
2. Wash-oil flow FIC-2020 is a critical minimum-flow constraint (wash bed coking).
3. VR bottoms temperature limited by quench (TIC-2026 -> FIC-2027); coil steam per pass FI.
4. Stream numbers (diamonds) refer to H&MB CFU-000-PR-HMB-001; data from design case, normal operation.
5. Pressures bar(g) unless noted. Pumps A/B are 2 x 100 %; only duty pump shown.
ID 2.6 m / 6.6 m / 3.0 m boot x 36.0
